board.events_source: The Bakersfield Guy #57 + Board Bored research sweep (downtown, venues, community)

events.name: First Friday Art Walk
events.blurb: Art, coffee, vintage, music — the downtown shops stay open late. Walk in, say hi, keep it local.
events.logistics_note: Streets stay open all night — every vendor spot is on the sidewalk, not the road. Keep at least 4 feet of clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians and wheelchair users at all times — never block a curb ramp, crosswalk, or building entrance. Booth zone: Eye St from Dagny's and Bakersfield Vintage (20th St) down to Encore and the parking garage (18th St), both sidewalks, plus the 19th & Eye corner extending east on 19th toward the 1400 block as the street opens up (skips the frontage directly in front of Jin Sushi at 1600 19th St). Spacing is based on a real 6ft vendor table (9ft pitch) — full corridor could theoretically hold ~386 booths both sides; these 86 are a denser starter layout, not the ceiling. Main parking: 18th & Eye Public Garage. Reserve a spot ahead via the vendor signup form, or just show up night-of.

vendors.name: Encore Boutique
vendors.note: $1 SALE — every rack. Here EVERY First Friday, not a one-off. Community pricing plus a curated First Friday rack up front.

vendors.name: Jerry's Pizza & Pub
vendors.note: Open for dine-in and drinks during First Friday.

vendors.name: Zama Latin American Cuisine
vendors.note: Latin American plates + seafood, dinner till midnight right on the corridor. Patio Club (21+) goes till 1:30am.

vendors.name: Art with Heart
vendors.note: Art gallery & studio, runs Form Fridays drop-in classes. Interested in First Friday — night-of hours to be confirmed.

record.notes: Bakersfield Vintage referred vendors who showed — first real-world proof the referral path works, and it came from the late-night anchor. Did the full run-through of the shops, walked and shopped. GAPS: fliers never got printed; no solid vendor-facing map existed on the night. Photos taken of 2 vendors to feature. Spot signups via Formspree: 0 ingested at time of record.
